  "code": "# 趋势分析：计算MA5/10/20，以及近20日斜率（线性回归）
import numpy as np

m2 = m.copy()
for w in [5,10,20]:
    m2[f'ma{w}'] = m2['close'].rolling(w).mean()

# 近20日线性斜率（元/日）
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

last20 = m2.dropna(subset=['close']).iloc[-20:]
X = np.arange(len(last20)).reshape(-1,1)
y = last20['close'].values
model = LinearRegression().fit(X,y)
slope = model.coef_[0]
# 预测20日的理论变动
chg20 = slope*20

slope, chg20, last20.index.min(), last20.index.max()"
}
